data.one_liner: Fast GBK codec for Dart, supports encoding/decoding and stream API.
data.what_it_does: Provides GBK encoding and decoding for strings and byte streams. It can be used with File I/O and HttpClient streams, mirroring the UTF-8 API.
use_when: You need to read or write GBK-encoded files or network responses.
You want a null‑safe, zero‑dependency codec that works on all platforms.
avoid_when: You already have a GBK codec in your project or you need a different character set.
strengths: Zero dependencies, works on all platforms.
Supports stream API for File and HttpClient.
Null‑safe and allows malformed input without throwing.
weaknesses: No tests shown in the repo.
